title: Canonical scalar-forgetful inverse-image comparison with adjunction and unit coherence
statement: Let k be a field, X and Y schemes, and a:Y → X any morphism. Let U_X,U_Y forget scalar actions on k-sheaves [new-sc-scalar-abelian-ext-factorization], and let L_k,L_ab be inverse image [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. There is a natural isomorphism c:L_k ⋙ U_Y ≅ U_X ⋙ L_ab such that for every k-sheaf F on X, G on Y, and q:L_k(F) → G, the abelian adjunct of c⁻¹_F followed by U_Y(q) equals U_X of the scalar adjunct of q. Furthermore the integer-unit sheaf map on Y followed by the forgotten inverse scalar tensor-unit comparison and c at the tensor unit equals the constant-integer inverse-image comparison followed by L_ab of the integer-unit map on X. Here integer-unit maps are homEquiv₀ of the explicitly defined degree-zero classes. No structure-sheaf coefficient equation is asserted.

proof.text: Invert the explicitly constructed adjunct comparison using its isomorphism theorem. Its adjunct formula gives the first conjunct. Compose the integer-unit comparison equation with its inverse and cancel hom followed by inv to get the second conjunct.

theorem scalar_forget_pullback_adjunction (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (a : Y ⟶ X) :
    let L := (Opens.map a.base).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
    ∃ c : scalarInverseImage (k := k) a ⋙ scalarAbelianForget k Y ≅
        scalarAbelianForget k X ⋙ L,
      (∀ (F : KSheaf X k) (G : KSheaf Y k)
        (q : (scalarInverseImage a).obj F ⟶ G),
        (((Opens.map a.base).sheafAdjunctionContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} _ _).homEquiv
          _ _) (c.inv.app F ≫ (scalarAbelianForget k Y).map q) =
        (scalarAbelianForget k X).map
          ((((Opens.map a.base).sheafAdjunctionContinuous (ModuleCat.{u} k) _ _).homEquiv
            _ _) q)) ∧
      Abelian.Ext.homEquiv₀ (scalarAbelianUnitClass k Y) ≫
          (scalarAbelianForget k Y).map (scalarInverseUnitIso a).inv ≫
          c.hom.app (𝟙_ (KSheaf X k)) =
        (((Opens.map a.base).constantSheafsheafPullbackIso AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
          isTerminalTop isTerminalTop).symm.app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))).hom ≫
        L.map (Abelian.Ext.homEquiv₀ (scalarAbelianUnitClass k X))
